featured_reviews.review_text:

featured_reviews.name: Aditi Mhatre
featured_reviews.review_text:
​I have been a regular customer of Chinese Village since I moved to Gorai four years ago, and it remains my absolute go-to for Chinese cuisine.
​The Highlights:
​The Chinese Food: Truly top-notch! While I’ve noticed the North Indian dishes have become a bit more "average" lately, the Chinese menu remains consistently excellent.
​Quality & Safety: One of the main reasons I keep coming back is the food quality. In four years, I have never had any digestive issues, which speaks volumes about their hygiene and ingredients.
​Service & Atmosphere: The ambiance is lovely, and the staff's hospitality is always warm and welcoming. Their home delivery service is also very reliable and prompt.
​My Personal Recommendations:
If you are visiting or ordering in, you have to try these:
​Kung Pao Chicken
​Teriyaki Chicken
​Chinese Village Special Rice
​Hakka Noodles
​Burnt Garlic Rice
​Chilli Garlic Noodles
​I highly recommend this place if you are craving authentic, high-quality Chinese food!

featured_reviews.name: Shubham Mathkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Let’s talk about the food first. Overall, the experience was okayish. The menu has a wide variety of options, which is definitely a plus, but unfortunately the taste didn’t quite live up to expectations.
We started with the Manchow Soup, and honestly, this was the highlight of the meal. The flavour was good, comforting, and well-balanced. The portion size was decent for the price, making it a value-for-money starter.
Next, we tried the Honey Coriander Chicken. The dish was average—for ₹300, we received six pieces of chicken, which felt a little less. It leaned more towards the sweet side, though the server had already informed us that it would be sweet with a hint of spice, so there were no surprises there.
After that came the Chicken Shanghai Rice. While the portion size was generous, the dish itself was quite disappointing. The chicken quantity was minimal, with more egg and paneer dominating the rice. The rice was dry and lacked flavour, which really took away from the overall experience.
On a positive note, the ambience of the restaurant was really nice. There’s also an open seating area, which adds to the vibe and makes it a pleasant place to sit and relax. The staff was courteous and helpful, patiently explaining the dishes when needed.
To sum it up, the restaurant scores well on ambience and service, but the food quality needs improvement. Overall, I’d rate this place 2 out of 5.

featured_reviews.name: Ramsha Tausalkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Juhu’s iconic Desi Chinese spot is now in Borivali. But what’s different about this Sagar Chinese? Well for starters, it is completely vegetarian and this time they have a Pan Asian menu. We had their 5-course set menu which had:
Sushi ( Crispy Chilli Tempura Sushi )
Bao ( Mystery Mushroom Bao )
Dimsum( Spinach & Corn Dimsum )
Hakka Noodles With Asian Greens
Nutella Cheesecake
We also ordered their special starters - the Manchow Soup and Paneer 65 Special and honestly? As a hardcore non vegetarian, we didn’t expect it to taste this good. They also have fun Indo Chinese options like these Cheese and Corn Kurkuri Wantons. The space is huge and spacious and the taste is legendary.

featured_reviews.name: amin shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Recently visited Sagar Chinese and honestly, this place is a paradise for pure veg Chinese lovers ✨🥢

The ambience is super aesthetic, cozy, and gives perfect family as well as friends hangout vibes. The service and management were also very warm and attentive throughout our visit.

We tried quite a variety from their menu and loved the overall experience!

What we tried:
• Veg Manchurian Dry
• Paneer 65
• Crispy Chilli Tempura Sushi
• Mystic Mushroom Bao
• Spinach & Corn Dimsum
• Hakka Noodles with Asian Greens
• Tiramisu
• Sagar Special Veg Chopper Schezwan Rice

Drinks:
• Marine Drive Mojito
• Sagar Special Punch
• Diet Coke

The sushi and bao were something unique and flavorful, while the Schezwan rice was spicy, comforting, and perfect for desi Chinese cravings 😍

If you’re looking for a pure veg Chinese spot in Borivali with good food, aesthetic ambience, and great service, this place definitely deserves a spot on your bucket list! 🍜✨

featured_reviews.name: SANDEEP MOHAN
featured_reviews.review_text: The food served was bland and without taste.The veg manchurian gravy was tasteless veg balls dumped into what appeared to be a watery manchow soup.The veg fried rice was equally disappointing.And there is something deeply unappetizing about the colours used in the food.It's garish and palpably artificial.The decor inside is fresh and attractive and comfortable but the seating is cramped.Only upi and cash is accepted.The prices are reasonable.The overall appearance is soothing and pleasant.If only they could improve upon the taste they can go places.They didn't serve any sizzler on 1st January, though it wasnt a weekend.I guess they stop whenever they are anticipating rush.

featured_reviews.review_text:

Service is slow and place is very noisy but worth going to.

featured_reviews.name: Meera Wadher
featured_reviews.review_text:
A really decent place for delicious indo-chinese cuisine! They have great quantity & quality of food! A must-try. Ordered spring rolls and a Veg Steak Sizzler, it was sufficient for 3-4 people. Glad to have found this place, pretty underrated + affordable + provides great service. There's some waiting time during weekends, but it's worth it because the food is amazing :)

They don't serve sizzlers on Sundays, so if you're going to try that, go on weekdays/Saturday instead!

Noodles -
They do have an amazing variety of noodles, btw. Tried their veg fried rice, veg hakka noodles and Phad Thai Phak Noodles. The Thai noodles tasted great, had different veggies and an exotic flavor...yummm!

Brownie -
I'm not much of a dessert person, but once I tried their sizzling walnut chocolate brownie, I changed my mind. Loved how the roasted walnut pieces blended in with the scoop of vanilla ice cream🤍

review_photos.caption: This is a bowl of half-eaten Phad Thai Phak Noodles, so the quantity is more than this. Basically, full to the brim.

featured_reviews.name: Sagar Parmar
featured_reviews.review_text: We recently visited for dinner with friends and, though we had to wait over half an hour, we were looking forward to a good time together. Upon entering, we were informed that our seating would be separate, which was disappointing as we wanted to enjoy the evening as a group of 8. After some discussion with the staff, they managed to arrange seating for us together, which we appreciated. The food, however, made up for any earlier issues. We started with Chinese bhel, which had a delightful crunch and unique flavors. The Sanjhi special sizzler was a highlight, full of vibrant taste and satisfying portions. Fried rice was well-prepared, and we ended with a warm brownie that hit the spot. The food was delicious, and we all left feeling happy and satisfied, ultimately making the evening a success despite the initial hiccup. Would recommend for the food, but it might help to check on seating arrangements ahead of time!

Had a wonderful dining experience at Choi Kim Cuisine in IC Colony. The vegetarian food was fresh, flavorful, and prepared perfectly. The dishes had authentic Indo-Chinese flavors without being overly greasy, and the portion sizes were generous.

The ambiance is cozy and welcoming, with a charming Chinese-inspired décor that creates a pleasant dining atmosphere. It’s a great place to enjoy a relaxed meal with family or friends. Sip n Spice – Indian-Chinese Fusion Redefined

featured_reviews.name: Vijaya Pohari
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently tried the Schezwan Chicken Lollipops and paneer momos at Sip N Spice, and my experience was truly outstanding. If you are a fan of Chinese starters, whether you are a local or a tourist like me, you must definitely try this dish at Sip N Spice. It is absolutely value for money.

featured_reviews.name: Aaron Dsa
featured_reviews.review_text:
Sip N Spice is a wonderful place for anyone who enjoys good food served with genuine care. The restaurant offers excellent value for money and consistently delivers on both taste and service.

The staff is courteous and attentive, making every visit a pleasant experience. A special mention must go to Vivek, the owner, who is always approachable and ready to provide outstanding service at any time. His commitment to customer satisfaction truly stands out.

The food here is consistently flavourful and well-prepared. Some dishes that are definitely worth trying include:

1. Honey Chilli Chicken

2. Lollipop Masala Dry

3. Chicken Crispy

4. Honey Chilli Lotus Stem

5. Chicken Burnt Chilli

Each of these dishes is prepared with care and has a distinctive taste that keeps you coming back for more.

Sip N Spice also offers home delivery to nearby locations, making it easy to enjoy their food from the comfort of your home.

Overall, it’s a place I would gladly recommend to anyone looking for a satisfying dining experience in Borivali West.

featured_reviews.name: Padmashree Verma
featured_reviews.review_text: Visited my friend’s newly opened restaurant “Sip N Spice” in Borivali! It’s a small joint with very yummy Veg & Non Veg Chinese cuisine! We tasted the Paneer chilli dry and Triple Schezwan Rice/ Noodle n Gravy combination! It was super yummy and paneer was very fresh and up to the mark! The staff was very helpful and polite and the ambience was cool! The place was really very clean and hygienic. Party orders can be placed here and price was economical! I highly recommend this restaurant to all! It’s a must try!

featured_reviews.name: Sushma Shivtarkar
featured_reviews.review_text: We wanted to have a good Chinese lunch so we ordered a mix of veg and non-veg dishes from Sip n Spice, Shimpoli. In starters, Chicken shezwan loliipop were awesome and in mains, Chicken chilly gravy was delicious. Veg soup n rice items were equally tasty. The portion size was quite good. Overall it was a great value for money lunch for our family. The food packaging seemed apt and hygienic.Highly recommended if you want to enjoy good Chinese meal.

I visited Trishiv Chinese & Bistro and absolutely loved the food! Best thing was the cheesy pasta.
The Hawa Hawai noodles, momos, and the Chinese platter were amazing — great taste and variety. Totally worth a visit and would definitely come back again 😍

featured_reviews.name: Srijitha Roy
featured_reviews.review_text:
Okay, hands down one of the best pure veg spots I’ve visited in Borivali! 🤤
Never thought I’d say this, but Surat-style Cheese Angoori Sabzi was an absolute game-changer, cheesy, creamy, and full of flavour. I finally get the hype!

I also tried their Palak Dal Khichdi served with ghee, papad, and dahi, which felt like a warm hug on a plate. Simple, soulful and honestly, perfect for comfort food cravings.

Now coming to their Dry Fruit Paneer and refreshing mocktails, such a great combo! Sweet, spicy, and rich in all the right ways. If you love fusion with a twist, this one's a must-try.

But the real surprise? Burasi Kebab with that green chutney, melt-in-mouth goodness. And I ended on a high with their Lotus Biscoff Waffle, dessert heaven! 🍯🧇

📍 Located in Borivali West
💸 Cost for two: ₹700 approx
👨‍👩‍👧 Perfect for family dinners, casual dates, or just chilling with your foodie gang.

Verdict:
If you're someone who thinks veg food can’t be exciting, Trishiv Bistro will prove you wrong. Big portions, pocket-friendly prices, and legit flavour bombs! Definitely saving this spot for repeat visits.

Rating: 4.8/5

featured_reviews.name: Carmel
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Trishiv Cafe recently and had a great experience overall.

We went for their buy one get one free offer on Neapolitan pizzas, and the quality was genuinely good. The pizzas were fresh, cheesy, and satisfying, and it didn’t feel like the offer affected the taste or portion in any way.

We also tried a couple of items from their mango seasonal menu, including the mango sticky rice and mango waffle with ice cream, which were both well made and worth trying.

The place has a nice, relaxed vibe and works well for a casual outing with friends. Overall, good food and a deal that actually makes sense.

We enjoyed a lot and had various food items like
